question: In which year was Dutch east India company founded?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1602.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dutch east India Company:**

 
 
• The Dutch East India Company was a duty trading company established in **1602**.
 
• In 1605, the Dutch established the first factory in India which was located at Masulipatnam.
 
• It's considered to be the first-ever transnational company.
 
• It was a huge association, with a base in nearly every country, employing further than 200 vessels and several thousand men.
 
• The Company was notorious for its power plays and harsh dealings.
